notes.title: Ladder Update Jan 8, 2024
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for trying my game and providing feedback!

[list]
[*] Fall damage more forgiving
[*] Overhauled ladder functionality - players will now snap to ladders on overlap or interaction, automatically exit at top and bottom, jump to jump off midway
[*] Footsteps sounds attached to players rather than playing in place
[*] Improved some collision in final arena to avoid boss getting stuck
[*] Fixed some effects missing in certain cases for enemies that use weapons like skeletons
[/list]
